The 30-minute lesson on context and memory (O3) is written, with a quiz and a cheat sheet. I haven't opened the lesson in a browser or measured its word count. By my planning estimate it is well inside the 2,700–6,750 word range for 30 minutes.

**Lesson:** `lessons/0001-context-and-memory.html`

By the end, Riley can decide whether each piece of information in the makerspace assistant belongs in context, in a saved note, or in a manual retrieved on demand, and say why. It covers:
- **The context window:** the model's "desk", and why bigger or fuller is not better (cost, and context rot).
- **Between steps:** the model keeps nothing, so the program re-sends the whole context on every call.
- **Between sessions:** nothing survives unless it was stored outside the model and loaded back. The lesson also corrects the "a bigger window is memory" mix-up.
- **Retrieval:** up-front versus just-in-time, and why a search can return the wrong page.
- **Notes:** `save_note` and `read_notes` as tools, saving short dated facts rather than transcripts.

It also has a recall warm-up on the agent loop, three figures and practice checks with feedback. A worked token-cost example is followed by a faded version. The lesson ends with a "where does it go?" exercise on the makerspace assistant.

**Quiz:** `quizzes/0002.json`, with its key in `keys/0002.json` (five items, none repeating the lesson's practice). I did not put any answers in this message.

**Cheat sheet:** `cheatsheets/context-and-memory.html`, one page with terms, a where-does-it-go table and the cost rule of thumb.

**Sources:** The primary source is Anthropic's [Effective context engineering for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents). The second is [Context windows are not memory](https://machinelearningmastery.com/context-windows-are-not-memory-what-ai-agent-developers-need-to-understand/), a secondary source. Both are in `RESOURCES.md`. I opened both pages this session, and every external link in the lesson comes from them.

**Things you may want to know:**
- The quiz reuses the existing misconception id M3 (the model remembers earlier chats on its own). I created no new misconception ids.
- I did not write a learning record, because Riley hasn't shown any understanding of this material yet.
- `RESOURCES.md` has no agent-builder community. I listed the makerspace staff and the faculty advisor as stand-ins and recorded the missing community under Gaps. Is there an online community Riley already uses that I should add?
- The lesson is numbered 0001 because `lessons/` was empty. The agent-loop lesson from the earlier session isn't in the workspace.
- `NOTES.md` has a line about this lesson.

Riley can ask me anything about the lesson in the chat, and the quiz is ready whenever they want it.
